caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic mug placed against a plain background. The mug is gray and features a slightly flared cylindrical body with horizontal bands near the base, leading to a solid, tiered foot. The handle is large and ornate, curving outward with a decorative scroll near its lower attachment to the mug. The shading and fine stippling suggest a smooth, reflective surface, and a vertical highlight line runs down the body, indicating the light source. The drawing is centered within a rectangular border, and the background is a pale beige color with slight texturing. There are no additional objects or elements in the composition.
title: Pewter Mug
